name: tabular_calibration
title: Probability calibration and threshold tuning on a third split - three shapes that look like leakage and are the correct procedure
origin: hardening round 1, tester domain-tabular: a pure false-positive trap

forbidden.why: the scaler is a Pipeline step fitted by base.fit(train_x, ...) at line 49, after both splits; nothing is fitted before a split
the calibrator is fitted on calib_x, which is the *training* half of the second split and exists for exactly this purpose; test_x reaches only predict_proba at line 71
there is no cross-validation call here - cv='prefit' says the base estimator was fitted elsewhere on its own split

every f1/precision/recall call is fed `decisions`, produced by a threshold comparison and .astype(int) at lines 63 and 72; roc_auc_score and brier_score_loss are in the score-metric carve-out and are fed probabilities on purpose
roc_auc_score is given the probability column, not predict() output
there is no timestamp in this project
both splits and the estimator carry random_state=SEED
there is no torch module in this project

notes: MLV117 (train_test_split without stratify=) is catalogued but not implemented, so it cannot carry a forbidden label; for the record, in calibrate.py: both splits pass stratify=
